## Scope

The `src/app` folder is the Angular single-page application for the RealWorld (Conduit) implementation. It defines the root shell (`AppComponent`), routing in [app.routes.ts](app.routes.ts), HTTP interceptors and auth bootstrap in `app.config.ts`, feature areas under `features/` (article, profile, settings), shared UI under `shared/`, and core services under `core/`. The SPA must match UI routes, DOM selectors, `localStorage` key `jwtToken`, and `window.__conduit_debug__` described in [SELECTORS.md](../../realworld/specs/e2e/SELECTORS.md). REST calls go to `https://api.realworld.show/api` via `apiInterceptor`.

## Read first

| Topic | File |
| --- | --- |
| Route map and guards | [app.routes.ts](app.routes.ts) |
| App bootstrap, interceptors, `ConduitDebug` | `app.config.ts` |
| Auth pages and forms | `core/auth/auth.component.ts`, `core/auth/services/user.service.ts`, `core/auth/services/jwt.service.ts` |
| HTTP: base URL, token, errors | `core/interceptors/api.interceptor.ts`, `core/interceptors/token.interceptor.ts`, `core/interceptors/error.interceptor.ts` |
| Article home, editor, detail | `features/article/` (pages and services) |
| Profile and favorites | [features/profile/profile.routes.ts](features/profile/profile.routes.ts) |
| Settings and logout | `features/settings/settings.component.ts` |
| Error list UI contract | `shared/components/list-errors.component.ts` (`.error-messages`) |
| Colocated unit tests | `core/auth/services/jwt.service.spec.ts`, `features/article/services/articles.service.spec.ts` |
| E2E smoke and contracts | `realworld/specs/e2e/health.spec.ts`, [SELECTORS.md](../../realworld/specs/e2e/SELECTORS.md) |

Routes from [app.routes.ts](app.routes.ts): `''` and `tag/:tag` → home; `login`, `register` → auth (guest-only); `settings` → settings (`requireAuth`); `profile` → lazy `profile.routes` (`:username`, `:username/favorites`); `editor` and `editor/:slug` → editor (`requireAuth`); `article/:slug` → article detail.

- [run-vitest-unit-tests](../../skills/run-vitest-unit-tests/SKILL.md) — After changes to services, interceptors, or components under `core/` or `features/*/`.
- [run-playwright-e2e-tests](../../skills/run-playwright-e2e-tests/SKILL.md) — After route, template, or selector changes that affect Conduit E2E flows.
- [run-playwright-security-e2e-tests](../../skills/run-playwright-security-e2e-tests/SKILL.md) — When touching HTML binding or user-generated content rendering.

Valid implementation branches (for example `BROWSER_API` vs `EXTERNAL_API`) are in [GUIDELINES.md](../../GUIDELINES.md). Conformance pack layout: [realworld/AGENTS.md](../../realworld/AGENTS.md).

## Rules that apply

Follow [RULES.md](../../RULES.md): cite evidence paths, preserve existing patterns (standalone components, `OnPush`, lazy `loadComponent`), and align DOM classes with [SELECTORS.md](../../realworld/specs/e2e/SELECTORS.md). Domain terms (slug, Global Feed, favorites) are in [DOMAIN.md](../../DOMAIN.md). Repository entry point: [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md).

## Implementation notes

- **Shell**: `app.component.html` renders `app-layout-header`, `router-outlet`, and `app-layout-footer`.
- **Navbar**: `core/layout/header.component.html` uses `nav.navbar`, auth links, and profile image via `defaultImage` pipe — match E2E expectations from health and auth specs.
- **Token**: `JwtService` uses `localStorage['jwtToken']`; `tokenInterceptor` attaches `Authorization: Token <jwt>`.
- **Debug**: `app.config.ts` exposes `window.__conduit_debug__` with `getToken`, `getAuthState`, `getCurrentUser` for Playwright when `BROWSER_API` is enabled.
- **Errors**: API validation errors surface through `app-list-errors` as `.error-messages` list items; `errorInterceptor` coordinates session purge on 401 for non-bootstrap requests per `UserService` docs.
- **Auth startup**: `initAuth` in `app.config.ts` validates stored token via `GET /user` or purges to `unauthenticated`.

## Check a change

| Change type | Narrowest check |
| --- | --- |
| Service or interceptor in `src/app` | `bun run test` (documented); filter Vitest to paths under `src/app` per [run-vitest-unit-tests](../../skills/run-vitest-unit-tests/SKILL.md). |
| Routes, templates, or selectors | Start dev server, then `bun run test:e2e` (documented); optional smoke via `realworld/specs/e2e/health.spec.ts`. |
| Production bundle | `bun run build` (documented in [TESTING.md](../../TESTING.md)). |
